evidence.note: Y-axis titled 'On-time departures (%)' with ticks 0%, 50%, 100%; the baseline at 0% is drawn as a visible axis line, and the side text says 'The axis starts at 0%.'

Q2 and Q3 bars sit side by side with value labels (Network 86%->81%, 12 Cross-town 85%->70%, 14 Cross-town 85%->74%, Other six 87%->87%), so the title's comparison (the two routes fell 14 and 11 points, the network 5) can be read off the chart; a labelled 'Target 90%' reference line is added.
